pending migrations.\n386\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n387\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n388\t\tif err != nil {\n389\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n390\t\t}\n391\t\n392\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n393\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n394\t\n395\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n396\t\t\tdb.Close()\n397\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n398\t\t}\n399\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n400\t\t\tdb.Close()\n401\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n402\t\t}\n403\t\n404\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n405\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n406\t\t\tdb.Close()\n407\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n408\t\t}\n409\t\treturn d, nil\n410\t}\n411\t\n412\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n413\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n414\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n415\t}\n416\t\n417\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n418\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n419\t\treturn d.db\n420\t}\n421\t\n422\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n423\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n424\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n425\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n426\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n427\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n428\t\t);`)\n429\t\tif err != nil {\n430\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n431\t\t}\n432\t\n433\t\tvar current int\n434\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n435\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n436\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n437\t\t}\n438\t\n439\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n440\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n441\t\t\tif version <= current {\n442\t\t\t\tcontinue\n443\t\t\t}\n444\t\n445\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n446\t\t\tif err != nil {\n447\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n448\t\t\t}\n449\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n450\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n451\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n452\t\t\t}\n453\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n454\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n455\t\t\t); err != nil {\n456\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n457\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n458\t\t\t}\n459\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n460\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n461\t\t\t}\n462\t\t}\n463\t\treturn nil\n464\t}\n465\t\n466\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n467\t\n468\t// GetGroup returns the group with the (processed_at);`,\n\t}\n// OpenDB opens (or creates) the SQLite database at path, enables WAL mode,\n// and applies any pending migrations.\nfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n\t}\n\n\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n\n\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\td := &DB{db: db}\n\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn d, nil\n}\n\n// Close closes the underlying database connection.\nfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n\treturn applies any\n// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\nfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n\t);`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tvar current int\n\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n\t\tversion := i + 1\n\t\tif version <= current {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── groups {\n\tvar sess Session\n\tvar createdAt, lastActive string\n\terr := s.Scan(\n\t\t&sess.ChatID, &sess.ThreadID, &sess.SessionID, &sess.CWD,\n\t\t&sess.Model, &sess.Status, &createdAt, &lastActive, &sess.MessageCount, &sess.IconColor,\n\t\t&sess.PinnedMessageID, &sess.TotalCostUSD, &sess.Summary, &sess.NotificationMode, &sess.TimeoutSec,\n\t\t&sess.DispatcherMode, &sess.TopicName, &sess.LastFromUserID,\n\t)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsess.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, createdAt)\n\tsess.LastActive, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, lastActive)\n\tif sess.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\tsess.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\treturn &sess, nil\n}\n\n// ── allowed_users context.Context, userID int64) (*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trow := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\n\tvar u time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\treturn &u, nil\n}\n\n// UpsertAllowedUser inserts or updates an allowed user.\nfunc (d *DB) UpsertAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, u *AllowedUser) error {\n\tif u.AddedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\tu.AddedAt = time.Now().UTC()\n\t}\n\tif u.Role == \"\" {\n\t\tu.Role = \"user\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO allowed_users (user_id, role, added_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n\t\t ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role`,\n\t\tu.UserID, u.Role, u.AddedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// DeleteAllowedUser (?, ?, ?)\n\t\t ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role`,\n\t\tu.UserID, u.Role, u.AddedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// ── sent_messages
